distribution: Local repository handoff only; no public push or packaging performed.

scope.environment: Actual Chrome against a copied native project
scope.fixtures: No DOM, source, trace or API mocks used for browser evidence
scope.preservation: Original project and installed application untouched; publication exercised only on disposable copied data

actual_browser.ordinary_inspect: Repeated active tab reselection retains tree, rows, canvas and scroll; no extra page/metadata reads
actual_browser.qc_identity: Three families, two rounds each: exact epoch, source, stream and recorded sample identity; canvas and trial list retained
actual_browser.predicate: Open, preview and close twice; builder retained during catalog refresh and dialog top stays constant
publication: Select two actual incoming rows and save the draft
Verify selected-only publication is rejected until explicitly reviewed
Inspect actual waveform/source/sample for both rows and mark reviewed
Preview and accept exactly two additions
Export the committed acceptance delta as Reference JSON
Click Download; verify exact two-epoch membership and artifact SHA-256

publication_result.native_replay: Identical full-payload acceptance and export retries returned identical receipts; no additional operation created
publication_result.native_oracle: Complete Main and pending UUID sets, all24 metadata parameters, full stream descriptors and source/cell identity match; prior export hash unchanged

limits: Timing is diagnostic, not a quiet-window benchmark: cloud synchronization and other correctness work continued.
Fresh owned browser checks do not certify every long-lived user-session behavior. Existing user tabs were inspected passively without navigation or reload.
First-entry cumulative preparation required Retry on the pinned publication frontend; lifecycle fix awaits actual served retest.
A same-cohort incoming draft save dropped focus and collapsed branches on the pinned frontend; continuity fix remains separately gated.
The1857-epoch whole-group tag/undo and inherited-cell-tag browser gates remain pending.
Optional hidden-mounted QC-return work was excluded because hidden dialogs and async authority require further work.
privacy: Private paths, author identities, epoch rows, request payloads, scope tokens and operation identifiers are omitted. Full private receipts remain with the runtime owners.
